findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The image drops to a fixed non-system identity before the entrypoint runs: a dedicated uid/gid 10001 account with /usr/sbin/nologin is created (lines 51-52) and USER 10001:10001 is set (line 60), with application code owned by root so the runtime user only reads it; a non-root process carries no ambient capabilities and nothing in the build grants any | verdict=pass confidence=high

findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: In the Dockerfile the image drops to a fixed non-system identity before the entrypoint runs: a dedicated uid/gid 10001 account with /usr/sbin/nologin is created (lines 51-52) and USER 10001:10001 is set (line 60), with application code owned by root so the runtime user only reads it. A non-root process carries no ambient capabilities, and nothing in the build grants any. The capability flags themselves are runtime settings, and the project's compose file applies how-to I940's recommended shape: cap_drop ALL on all three services, with the web service adding none, the proxy adding only CHOWN, SETUID and SETGID (lines 103-106) and the database only CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, SETUID and SETGID (lines 162-167), plus no-new-privileges:true; no service sets privileged | verdict=pass confidence=high
